Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a specialized proximity labeling method (BAR) to capture interactomes of alpha-synuclein. While the study targets phosphorylated alpha-synuclein (PSER129) as a bait for the proximity labeling, the MS analysis itself is a bottom-up LFQ approach of the captured proteins, not a phosphoproteome enrichment of the whole lysate. Acquisition is inferred as DDA based on the use of MaxQuant/Mascot and the Orbitrap Fusion instrument in a standard discovery proteomics context.

scope: Biotinylated proteins were captured using 40 μL of streptavidin-coated magnetic beads (Thermo Fisher, Catalog No. PI88817) at room temperature for two hours.
